ns2:section.sectionText: Grand Challenge 9: Reverse Engineer the Brain - Based on the National Academy of Engineering's 14 Identifiable grand challenges, this course will enhance your ability to stimulate the critical thiking skills and project development surrounding these challenges, which have the potential to make a global impact. Together with fellow students and a faculty advisor, you focus on a subset of the listed challenges for this section to enhance your ability to address real world problems as an engineer. http://www.engineeringchallenges.org/cms/cvhallenges.aspx
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
